params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). A row of five plain dark envelopes standing in a rack, only one of them opened with warm light inside — most stay silent. Single warm key light, deep coffee-brown shadows, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze, subtle golden dust. The object sits in the lower third of the frame; the upper 60% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm mood.
